item.label: Spreading mortar and adjusting parallel stretcher bricks on edge
item.description: In a close-up low-angle shot over a base course of bricks laid vertically on end/edge in sandy soil, ent_worker_left uses a red-handled trowel to scoop wet grey mortar from a metal pan and spread it along the top of the base course (0.00s–7.80s). Simultaneously, ent_mason_right adjusts a pair of parallel stretcher bricks laid on their narrow edge (0.00s–0.80s), steps back briefly, then places and aligns another front stretcher brick on edge onto the fresh mortar bed (2.80s–7.80s), leaving a narrow hollow gap between the front and back parallel bricks.

item.label: Placing cross header brick on edge and rear stretcher brick on edge
item.description: While ent_worker_left finishes smoothing the mortar bed on the left and withdraws the mortar pan and trowel out of the left frame edge by about 12.20s, ent_mason_right brings in a brick from above and sets it transversely on edge across the wall width as a header/shiner bridging the cavity (8.80s–12.10s). Next, ent_mason_right picks up another brick from the ground behind the wall (12.50s–13.00s), places it longitudinally on edge along the rear face of the wall (13.00s–15.00s), and then lifts and repositions it slightly to improve alignment on the mortar bed (15.00s–18.30s).
item.context_result: The transverse header brick and the rear longitudinal stretcher brick are positioned on edge on the mortar bed, forming three sides of the next hollow cavity pocket.
item.camera_framing: Static close-up; left worker exits left frame around 12.20s.

item.label: Placing matching front stretcher brick on edge to enclose cavity and stepping back
